intro: Riga rewards visitors with a walkable old town, vibrant markets, and green parks along the Daugava. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Trams, buses, and trolleybuses run by Rigas Satiksme; single fare €1.50 valid 90 minutes with transfers.
Buy tickets via Mobilly app, Narvesen shops, or ticket machines; activate by scanning the vehicle QR code.
24-hour pass costs €5, 3-day €8, 5-day €10; public transport is free on some holidays.
Ride apps Bolt, Panda Taxi, and Red Cab work well; avoid hailing random street taxis.
Driving is not advised due to traffic and parking fees up to €8/hour in the old town.
Old Town is best on foot; cobblestones are rough. Bikes and e-scooters are common April to September.
Seasonal boat to Jūrmala runs May to September, €15-20, about 2.5 hours.

oldtown.name: Riga Old Town
oldtown.tip: Start at Town Hall Square and wander the cobbled lanes; wear flat shoes.

blackheads.price_text: ≈ EUR 6–8 adult; check on the day
blackheads.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00; check on the day
blackheads.tip: Look up at the ornate facade from the square before going in.

freedom.name: Freedom Monument
freedom.tip: Watch the honour guard change; stand back and don't block the ceremony.

artnouveau.name: Art Nouveau District
artnouveau.price_text: Free to walk; museum entry extra
artnouveau.tip: Focus on Alberta iela and Elizabetes iela; look up at the facades.

market.name: Riga Central Market
market.price_text: Free to enter; pay per item
market.hours: Daily roughly 07:00–18:00; check on the day
market.tip: Try rye bread, smoked fish and local cheese; bring small cash.

stpeters.name: St. Peter's Church
stpeters.price_text: ≈ EUR 8–10 with tower; check on the day
stpeters.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
stpeters.tip: The tower lift gives the best Old Town view; go on a clear day.

daugava.name: Daugava River
daugava.tip: Walk the promenade toward the bridges at sunset for skyline views.

greypeas.name: Grey Peas with Bacon
greypeas.hours: Served at lunch and dinner in many Old Town restaurants
greypeas.tip: A classic Latvian dish; order it with rye bread and a local beer.

jurmala.name: Jūrmala Resort
jurmala.tip: Take a train from Riga and walk from Majori station to the long sandy beach.

motormuseum.name: Riga Motormuseum
motormuseum.price_text: ≈ EUR 8–12 adult; check on the day
motormuseum.hours: Closed Monday; roughly 10:00–18:00; check on the day
motormuseum.tip: Good for car fans and families; allow a couple of hours.

skyline_bar.name: Rooftop bar with Old Town view
skyline_bar.hours: Afternoon to late evening; check on the day
skyline_bar.tip: Go before sunset for a drink and photos over the rooftops.

kalnciema.name: Kalnciema Quarter Market
kalnciema.price_text: Free to enter; pay per item
kalnciema.hours: Mainly weekends; check on the day
kalnciema.tip: Wooden-architecture quarter with a weekend food and craft market.

maskacka_walk.name: Maskačka neighbourhood walk
maskacka_walk.tip: Explore the wooden houses and creative spaces; stay on main streets after dark.

free_tour.name: Old Town walking tour
free_tour.hours: Usually daily late morning; check on the day
free_tour.tip: Book a tip-based tour on day one to get your bearings.

bastejkalns.name: Bastejkalns Park and canal
bastejkalns.tip: A green break between Old Town and the Art Nouveau District.

boat_tour.name: Canal and Daugava boat tour
boat_tour.hours: Daytime in season; check on the day
boat_tour.tip: Sit outside for views of the Old Town skyline from the water.

stays.why: Walk to the cathedral, squares and museums. Noisy at night and cobblestones are rough; ask for a quiet room.
Art Nouveau district and good cafés; 10–15 minutes on foot to the Old Town. Good transport links.
Quiet wooden-house streets across the river, near the market and parks. Cheaper; cross the bridge to the centre.
Local, budget-friendly neighbourhood with the central market nearby. Simple tram or bus ride to the centre.

food: Try Latvian dishes: grey peas with bacon, rye bread, and smoked fish. Lunch menus are the best value.
Riga Central Market: old zeppelin hangars with cheese, berries, smoked meat and cheap snacks.
Book ahead for popular Old Town restaurants in summer; walk-ins fill up after 19:00.
Lido is a good budget canteen chain for hearty local food; pay by weight.
Black balsam is the local herbal liqueur. Sip it slowly or try it in a cocktail.
more_time: Swap an afternoon for Jūrmala: seasonal boat May to September, €15–20, about 2.5 hours, or a short train ride.
Add the Art Nouveau district walk on Alberta iela and the nearby museum if you like architecture.
History fans can add a half-day at the occupation museum or the Soviet-era sights outside the centre.
